sourceMappingDecisions: Twenty rows map to eighteen articles: seventeen new articles and the stable existing 巻く.
交ざる shares entry1603920/まざる with 混ざる; 交じる shares entry1603930/まじる with 混じる. Teach each source alias explicitly in one canonical article, not duplicate cards.
蒔く2611890, 撒く1303400 and reused 巻く1211200 are separate まく identities, not aliases of 幕.
巻く retains its identity, primary reading, title and existing exclusions; a sourced N2 level and narrow explicitly recorded additions are allowed.
inspectionStageAdvance.stage: Actual author reads completed before card drafting; not independent certification.
sourceAccessLimits: All thirteen complete selected family chunks, nineteen complete older-body chunks and the complete three-kanji chunk actually read. Principal families are included in the union, not added twice.
Three supplemental families/twelve senses and five complete direct older-body reads give actual unions309/799 and156. Larger prepared dictionary availability is not actual inspection.
All200 navigation labels and22 complete component records read. Complete front matter of older bodies also supplies any additional labels; navigation labels alone are not body evidence.
All twenty frozen public wrappers actually read. They come from one Digital Daijisen authority via Weblio, not twenty independent dictionaries or frequency evidence.
The 枕 wrapper's ちん character heading, 混じる wrapper's こんじる verb, and マスク wrapper's Masuku/musk headings are unrelated to the assigned reading/identity and not imported into teaching.
The confusable inventory was read through line157, with a small repeated tail and targeted batch searches, not in its entirety.
何枚 and 原来 were absent as headwords from the pinned dictionary. Removing them from the strict collector does not establish that a compositional Japanese phrase is invalid.
混/交 spelling contrasts are dictionary-qualified tendencies, not strict liquids/solids partitions. まじる is godan; the separate こんじる entry is not its conjugation model.
Author inspection is not independent review, exhaustive semantic uniqueness, native-speaker certification, measured frequency or measured model-bias reduction.

postDraftInspectionAdvance.stage: After initial card drafting, before independent review; not retrospectively counted as pre-card inspection.

quizGuardRationale: Direct symmetric nontransitive hypotheses from complete titles, older bodies and ordinary secondary senses; no category clique or automatic noun/verb exemption. Initial independent review may reject excesses or find omissions.
盆地 is enclosed basin terrain, not every plain, washbasin or river drainage area. 本部 central/head office is compared directly with 事務所 rather than every workplace or community center.
本来 includes original, inherent, proper and normal/rightful uses; 元, 普通 and 正しい labels can overlap. It is not every past-time adverb or every claim of truth/reality.

まあまあ includes passable/reasonable evaluations and calming/surprised interjections. まあ, good/acceptable labels and pass grades are assessed directly, not every mild/moderate quantity or justified argument.

枚数 is a flat-item count; 数, 量, 点数 and broad number ナンバー labels are protected, while actual uses distinguish identifying numbers from counts. A counter or written numeral is not automatically the number of items.

毎度 includes each-time, always/often and familiar customer greeting/thanks. Frequency and actual thanks/greeting titles are considered independently, not every calendar expression or every gratitude-related noun.

マイナス ordinary subtraction, deficit/loss, drawback and bad/negative senses motivate arithmetic, loss/disadvantage and flaw/weakness comparisons. A defeat, any damage-causing action and every decrease are not automatically identical.

巻く preserves its four original guards. Passive enveloping overlaps 覆う; scarf-wearing can overlap 着る's broad wear label; roll labels 転がる/転がす are compared without claiming the same movement or blanket transitivity interchange.

蒔く and 撒く remain separate entries despite seed-scattering and lacquer-powder sprinkling overlap. 撒く includes flyer distribution and losing a pursuer, not merely untidy scattering; not every delivery, plant organism or movement manner is synonymous.
枕 includes pillow and introductory speech/rakugo lead-in. Introduction labels はじめに/紹介/概論 are guarded without asserting all people-introduction, referral and general-survey uses are interchangeable.

曲げる includes physical bend/tilt and figurative distort/yield. 曲る, curve, fold, tilt, twist and 譲る labels are assessed against actual secondary senses, not every snap, break, disregard or twisting activity by association.
まごまご includes confused/flustered/at-a-loss senses. あわてる, うろうろ, 混乱, 困る, ぐずぐず and 迷う were considered from complete bodies and full families; not every intentional hesitation is confusion.
摩擦 includes physical rubbing and social discord. 擦る/ごしごし and clash/opposition/dispute labels are assessed directly; rubbing does not automatically mean polishing, cleanliness or a collision.

混ざる/混じる include material mixing and association/joining, with qualified spelling tendencies. Direct mixing/combination and actual joining/association labels are protected individually; not every crowding, meeting, cooperation, matching or dissolving word is synonymous.

混ぜる is transitive mix/stir/blend, with direct mixture/combination and liquid-mixing comparisons. Intransitive forms receive direct pair declarations despite different conjugation; no assumption that all social-relationship words follow transitively.
マスク includes face covering and facial looks, directly overlapping 面 and 顔. Expression 表情 is not automatically facial structure, and unrelated musk/place-name headings do not establish another sense.
sourceAccessLimits: All thirteen complete selected family chunks, nineteen complete older-body chunks and the complete three-kanji chunk actually read. Principal families are included in the union, not added twice.
Three supplemental families/twelve senses and five complete direct older-body reads give actual unions309/799 and156. Larger prepared dictionary availability is not actual inspection.
All200 navigation labels and22 complete component records read. Complete front matter of older bodies also supplies any additional labels; navigation labels alone are not body evidence.
All twenty frozen public wrappers actually read. They come from one Digital Daijisen authority via Weblio, not twenty independent dictionaries or frequency evidence.
The 枕 wrapper's ちん character heading, 混じる wrapper's こんじる verb, and マスク wrapper's Masuku/musk headings are unrelated to the assigned reading/identity and not imported into teaching.
The confusable inventory was read through line157, with a small repeated tail and targeted batch searches, not in its entirety.
何枚 and 原来 were absent as headwords from the pinned dictionary. Removing them from the strict collector does not establish that a compositional Japanese phrase is invalid.
混/交 spelling contrasts are dictionary-qualified tendencies, not strict liquids/solids partitions. まじる is godan; the separate こんじる entry is not its conjugation model.
Author inspection is not independent review, exhaustive semantic uniqueness, native-speaker certification, measured frequency or measured model-bias reduction.
